If slot b does not come up: it gets 3 tries. Hold the power button 10 s to force each restart; after the third
failed start systemd-boot starts slot a again by itself, with /data as it was. To pick a slot by hand: hold a key
while powering on and choose "OpenBook (17 · slot A)". Slot b counts as good once Android has booted it
(markBootSuccessful); from then on update_engine merges, and slot a is no longer a fallback.
